_doc: 问题→必答。每个 expect 的数字都来自第二条手写 SQL 路线（psql 直查 new_coldchain；见 generated/verification/truth_route.sql）。
带 route 的样本在闸门里现场跑第二遍 SQL（不是比上月冻结的数字）；只有无法一次写清的多行比较才用 rows。
比率指标 :scale "100.0" 只改呈现，闸门用 _same_unit 两种单位都接受，所以这里写原始比率（0.9459 而不是 94.59）。
refused_by_name：本体按名拒绝（分组没有声明）。unresolved：profile 还挂着、但本体其实答不了或答得不诚实的样本 —— 每条写着缺哪条声明、以及第二路线给出的数字。

expect.route: SELECT 1.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.on_time)/count(*) FROM stops s JOIN trips t ON s.trip_id=t.id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-10-29'
SELECT 1.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_boxes >= box_capacity_snapshot OR load_volume >= volume_capacity_snapshot OR load_weight >= weight_capacity_snapshot)/count(*) FROM trips
SELECT 1.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_weight >= weight_capacity_snapshot)/count(*) FROM trips
SELECT 1.0*(SELECT count(DISTINCT trip_id) FROM incident_tickets)/(SELECT count(*) FROM trips)
SELECT 1.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'attended')/count(*) FILTER (WHERE scheduled) FROM driver_schedule
SELECT round(sum(revenue - cost_total), 2) FROM trips WHERE is_external

SELECT route_version, 1.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_boxes >= box_capacity_snapshot OR load_volume >= volume_capacity_snapshot OR load_weight >= weight_capacity_snapshot)/count(*) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT t.route_version, count(*) FROM stops s JOIN trips t ON s.trip_id = t.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

nothing declares a grouping by ['片区']

expect.unresolved: 缺一条「相对时间窗必须拒绝或先锚定」的声明。:TimeWindow 只在 grain 自带 :timeColumn 时生效，引擎把「最近30天」解成 today-30d…today（今天是 2026-11-09 → 2026-10-10…2026-11-09），而本库数据止于 2026-10-29，于是答案 800 趟其实是「最近20天」；按数据末日锚定的真值是 1200 趟（trip_date > max(trip_date)-30d）。要么把这个问法写进拒绝清单，要么声明一个 anchor=max(trip_date) 的窗口解析 —— 需要业务确认，不由我定。
